applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 near southern overhead electric lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed present along southern property boundary running near Buildings 6, 7, 8. No surveyed elevations of overhead conductors or clearance dimension annotations provided on building elevation sheets to verify minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor is maintained.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 and site features near overhead distribution conductors
findings.comment: Distribution overhead lines confirmed present on site. No plan or section exhibits provided showing dimensions from outside conductor to customer facilities (buildings, walls, poles, signs) to verify minimum 15-foot radial clearance in all directions from outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 projections near overhead lines on southern boundary
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed running along southern boundary. No building elevation sheets or section views provided showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, roofs) with clearance dimension annotations to verify both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from outside conductor.

applicableAreas: Western property boundary along Valley View Road
findings.comment: Overhead utility poles and lines confirmed in Valley View Road right-of-way adjacent to western site boundary. No surveyed conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations provided on site plan or building elevations to verify buildings maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal and 15-foot radial clearances from overhead electric facilities in ROW.

applicableAreas: All buildings, particularly Buildings 6, 7, 8 near southern overhead lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric facilities confirmed present on existing conditions survey. No building elevation sheets provided with surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors with clearance dimension annotations to demonstrate required clearances are met.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 and site structures near overhead lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed on site plan. No section and plan view exhibits provided showing dimension lines from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings and building projections for clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Fences throughout site, particularly southern boundary
findings.comment: Fences shown on site plan and overhead electric lines confirmed present. No clearance dimension annotations provided on site plan showing fences maintain minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from outside conductor of overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Fence alignments near existing utility poles on western and southern boundaries
findings.comment: Utility poles confirmed at multiple locations on existing survey and site plan. Fences shown on site plan, but no dimension annotations provided verifying fence posts maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from overhead electric pole locations.

applicableAreas: Vehicle barrier areas if proposed beneath overhead lines on southern boundary
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed present. If vehicle barriers or barrier posts are proposed beneath overhead lines, no section exhibits or clearance dimension annotations provided showing minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance from outermost conductor.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls along southern property boundary near overhead lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed along southern boundary where retaining walls are proposed. Retaining wall sections provided on Sheets 38-39 show structural details but lack clearance dimension annotations from outermost electric conductor to wall face to verify minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Retaining walls on southern boundary near overhead lines
findings.comment: Retaining wall details provided on Sheets 38-39. Section views do not include dimension annotations from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of retaining wall face for clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Driveways throughout site, particularly those near overhead lines on southern boundary
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed on site. Grading plan and site plan show driveway alignments and finished floor/grade elevations but no section views or dimension annotations provided showing minimum vertical clearance (16-foot for parking without truck traffic, 18-foot for areas with truck traffic) from lowest point of overhead electric facilities to driveway surface.

applicableAreas: Vehicle parking areas if any are beneath overhead lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed present on southern boundary. If parking areas are located beneath overhead lines, no section views or clearance dimension annotations provided showing minimum vertical clearance (16-18 feet depending on truck traffic) from lowest overhead lines to parking surface, and no note addressing clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: All overhead electric facilities on and adjacent to site
findings.comment: Overhead electric facilities confirmed present on site. No clearance dimension annotations visible on plans. Where clearance dimensions exist, cannot verify whether dimensions originate from outside conductor (as required) or from utility pole centerline. On multi-conductor installations, conductor may be several feet offset from pole center; measuring from pole instead of conductor results in understated clearances.

applicableAreas: Site plan streetlight locations
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed on site along southern and western boundaries. Site plan shows lighting but cannot definitively determine if any proposed streetlight poles are positioned under overhead line routing without detailed section views showing spatial relationships and clearances.

applicableAreas: Sidewalks along Valley View Road right-of-way where power poles exist
findings.comment: Utility poles confirmed in Valley View Road right-of-way adjacent to western property boundary. Site plan shows sidewalk alignments but lacks dimension annotations or notes verifying sidewalks are cleared from existing power poles at property line intersections.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings, structures, and features within or near electric easement boundaries on southern and western site boundaries
findings.comment: Overhead distribution facilities confirmed present on and adjacent to site with 5-foot electric easement boundaries. Site plan and grading plan show proposed buildings and structures but lack clearance verification dimensions from outside conductor to all features within or near easement boundaries to confirm no facilities violate the absolute prohibition on items installed under/over distribution lines or to verify minimum 7.5-foot clearance from conductor for items within easement.

applicableAreas: Water meter location if shown on site
findings.comment: Overhead electric service drops may exist on site. Utility plan sheets do not show explicit clearance dimension annotations from overhead electric service drop conductors to water meter location verifying minimum 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Water line routing across site
findings.comment: Overhead distribution facilities confirmed present on site. Utility tap and water line plans shown but lack clearance dimension annotations verifying water lines maintain clearances from existing overhead electrical distribution facilities.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, 8 near southern overhead lines; driveways beneath overhead facilities
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed present along southern boundary near buildings and driveways. Based on site elevation data and estimated overhead line heights, vertical clearances appear marginal. No registered surveyor survey data provided showing measured pole locations and mid-span clearances to verify proposed site features maintain minimum 7.5-foot sky-to-ground, 16-foot (parking), or 18-foot (truck traffic) vertical clearances.

applicableAreas: Any marquee signs if proposed near overhead facilities
findings.comment: Overhead electric facilities confirmed on site. No marquee signs are evidently proposed; if any are shown on addressing or sign plans, no profile exhibits or clearance verification dimensions provided from electrical conductors to sign features.

applicableAreas: Decorative lighting locations throughout site, particularly near overhead lines
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed present on site. Site plan and landscape plan show lighting fixtures but lack clearance verification dimensions from overhead lines to verify decorative lighting maintains 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances, or lacks relocation notes if clearances cannot be met.

applicableAreas: Tree plantings throughout site, particularly those within 10 feet of overhead distribution conductors or 50 feet of transmission conductors
findings.comment: Overhead distribution conductors confirmed present on site, with overhead line routing visible on landscape plan. Landscape plan shows tree plantings but lacks: (1) distance annotations (lateral/horizontal) showing tree locations relative to overhead conductors; (2) tree species identification verified against ECM Appendix F 'UC' (Utility Compatible) list; (3) confirmation that trees within 10 feet of distribution conductors are utility-compatible species (generally ≤20 feet mature height). Tree list provided but cannot cross-reference species to utility compatibility without access to ECM Appendix F.

applicableAreas: Electric meter locations
findings.comment: Electrical design plan shows meter locations but lacks enlarged details or notes confirming meters are not obstructed by site features, structures, landscaping, or building projections, and that 30-inch-wide front space, 36-inch front depth, and 6.5-foot headroom requirements per UCM § 1.10.9 are maintained.

applicableAreas: Existing electric pole down guy wire anchor locations relative to proposed accessible paths, driveways, and site features
findings.comment: Overhead utility poles confirmed on existing survey (Sheet 4). Down guy wire anchor locations and potential conflicts with proposed accessible paths, driveways, and site features cannot be verified from current plans. Electric utility infrastructure (including down guy anchors) is frequently omitted from standard site surveys. Existing conditions survey and site plan lack explicit callouts of guy anchor locations or resolution notes addressing potential conflicts.

applicableAreas: Transformer locations if shown on site
findings.comment: Preliminary electrical design plan shows transformer pad locations. No section views or clearance verification dimensions provided from overhead electric line conductors to top of transformer equipment to verify minimum 7.5-foot vertical sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Construction staging and equipment operation zones on site
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed on site. Erosion control plan and site plan show construction staging areas but lack clearance verification dimensions or notes confirming construction staging areas, equipment operation zones, crane swing radius areas, and work platforms maintain minimum 10-foot radial clearance from energized overhead electric lines per OSHA and Texas law during construction (distinct from permanent clearance requirements).

applicableAreas: Cover sheet general notes
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines confirmed present on and adjacent to site. Sheet 3, Block 9 contains a 48-hour pre-construction safety meeting note with Austin Energy, but this note applies specifically to TRANSMISSION facilities (voltage ≥60kV) and transmission easement work. No comparable 48-hour notification note identified that applies to DISTRIBUTION facilities (voltage <60kV) per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 requirement for work near high-voltage lines. Applicability of transmission-specific note to distribution facilities requires clarification.
